summary_en: Kyoto Financial Group raised its FY2027 dividend forecast by 20 yen per share to 75 yen for the year-end dividend and 125 yen for full-year, reflecting upward revision of net income forecast to 60.0 billion yen due to stronger-than-expected subsidiary banking performance.
title_en: Notice Regarding Revision of Full-Year Earnings Forecast and Revision of Year-End Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase) for the Fiscal Year Ending March 31, 2027
translation_en_brief:
Kyoto Financial Group revised its dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027, increasing the year-end dividend from 55 yen to 75 yen per share, representing a 20 yen increase. Combined with the interim dividend of 50 yen, the full-year dividend is now projected at 125 yen per share.

The company raised its full-year earnings forecast due to stronger-than-expected performance at its subsidiary banks. Consolidated ordinary revenue is now projected at 250.4 billion yen (up 10.8% from previous forecast of 225.9 billion yen), operating profit at 86.7 billion yen (up 13.1%), and net income attributable to parent company shareholders at 60.0 billion yen (up 15.3% from 52.0 billion yen). These improvements were driven by better-than-anticipated interest income and fee-based revenue.

For reference, the prior fiscal year (ended March 31, 2026) included a gain on the sale of Nintendo shares and recorded an annual dividend of 180 yen (40 yen interim and 140 yen year-end, with the latter including 100 yen in special dividends).
